title: Mid-Term Endorsement Fees and Coverage A Increase Limit — Homeowners Insurance
content:
Two HomeShield program figures apply to mid-term endorsements on Homeowners Insurance: the fee per mid-term endorsement requested by the insured, and the largest mid-term increase in Coverage A that can be made without re-underwriting.

| Program | Fee per insured-requested mid-term endorsement (USD) | Largest mid-term Coverage A increase without re-underwriting |
|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Essential | 25.00 | 20 percent |
| HomeShield Standard | 25.00 | 20 percent |
| HomeShield Plus | 15.00 | 20 percent |
| HomeShield Preferred | 15.00 | 20 percent |
| HomeShield Premier | 0.00 | 20 percent |
| HomeShield Estate | 0.00 | 20 percent |

The increase limit is 20 percent in every program. The endorsement fee is 25.00 dollars under HomeShield Essential and Standard, 15.00 dollars under HomeShield Plus and Preferred, and nothing under HomeShield Premier and Estate.

**Illustration (hypothetical Coverage A of 350,000 dollars).** A 20 percent increase is 70,000 dollars, so the largest mid-term Coverage A that this limit permits is 420,000 dollars.
